mapper.select: SELECT o.id FROM pf.workspace_environment_operation o JOIN pf.workspace_environment e ON e.operation_id=o.id WHERE o.status IN('CLAIMED','RUNNING') AND(o.lease_until<=clock_timestamp() OR o.deadline_at<=clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY o.created_at LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.workspace_environment_operation SET status='UNKNOWN',effect_state='MAY_HAVE_STARTED',error_code='ENVIRONMENT_OWNER_EXPIRED',version=version+1 WHERE id=#{operationId} AND status IN('CLAIMED','RUNNING') AND(lease_until<=clock_timestamp() OR deadline_at<=clock_timestamp())
mapper.select: SELECT o.id FROM pf.workspace_environment e JOIN pf.workspace_environment_operation o ON o.id=e.operation_id WHERE e.state='READY' AND o.status='COMMITTED' AND o.kind='PREPARE' ORDER BY e.last_activity_at LIMIT 1
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace_environment WHERE id=#{environmentId} AND state='READY' AND last_activity_at<=clock_timestamp()-interval '60 seconds')
